_comment: Decidr Weekly Marketing Report — Week 30 (20–26 Jul 2026). HubSpot funnel/product/channel/SQL/company-size pulled live 2026-07-27. Meta/LinkedIn/Google spend from Supermetrics (AUD). Geography omitted (country property permission-restricted). Website/GA4 + creatives placeholder. NEW: employeeSize section.

highlight.html: A repeat of last week — headline SQLs inflated by a Partnerships bulk import, paid demand quiet. 315 new contacts (257 subscribers + 58 qualified). The funnel shows 46 SQL+, but 39 are a one-off Partnerships Offline import (same pattern as Week 29) — strip it out and marketing SQL+ ≈ 7 (1 DecidrOS via Facebook, 6 Unassigned incl. 5 sales-created opps). Paid social was quiet: Meta spend wound down to $3,209 and produced just 1 MQL+; the State of AI event drove 22 contacts but 0 MQL (its qualifying tail has passed), and AI Roadmap is effectively off ($138). Google brand-search reconnected ($405). New this week: a company-size cut shows our captured leads skew to small businesses (1–20 employees), below the 250+ ICP.

sqlByProduct.note: MQL+ by product. Partnerships 40 is almost entirely a bulk Offline SQL import (39) — not organic; the same happened in Week 29. DecidrOS 2 MQL+ (1 SQL); Sugarworks just 1 lead this week (0 MQL) — continuing its low volume across recent weeks; Unassigned 6 (5 sales-created opps + 1 SQL). Excluding the Partnerships bulk, marketing SQL+ ≈ 7.

employeeSize.note: Company size is captured for only 55 of 315 contacts (17%) — the other 260 have no size on file. Of known sizes, the vast majority are small businesses (1–20 employees); just 6 sit at 500+, the enterprise end of the 250+ ICP for Sugarworks/DecidrOS. Adding a company-size question to the lead forms would let marketing filter to ICP-fit leads. Source: HubSpot 'total_number_of_employees' (bands normalized from mixed formats).

observations.html: Partnerships bulk import — again. 39 of 46 SQL+ are a repeat Offline bulk (same as Week 29). Real marketing SQL+ ≈ 7. These imports should be tagged/excluded from the weekly SQL headline, or the funnel reads far healthier than organic demand actually is.

NEW — lead quality skews below ICP. Where company size is known (only 17% of contacts), the largest band is 1–20 employees (small business). Only 6 known contacts are 500+ employees — the Sugarworks/DecidrOS ICP is 250+. Paid targeting may be pulling in sub-ICP small businesses.

NEW — company size is 83% blank. 260 of 315 contacts have no employee count captured. Adding a company-size field to the lead forms would let marketing filter and report on ICP fit — currently impossible for most leads.

Paid social went quiet. 58 contacts, just 2 MQL+ (the quietest paid week in the series). Meta spend nearly halved to $3,209; the State of AI event drove 22 contacts but 0 MQL as its qualifying tail passed.
AI Roadmap is effectively off. $138 spend and no contacts this week — the wind-down from Week 29 (1 lead) is now complete. Decide whether to retire it or relaunch with fresh creative.
Google reconnected. After last week's token expiry, Google brand-search is flowing again — $405, 0 HubSpot contacts (brand search rarely captures new leads directly).
All 5 opportunities were sales-created. James Hinsley, Allan Dajano, Markus Cohnen, Nathan Reeves (+1) entered via CRM / extension / BCC — no marketing-sourced opportunities this week.
